summary: Lawyer Harlow tells Emma her grandfather left her fifty-one percent of Blake Group, and Ryan's family has no idea. Emma signs the transfer and calls a board meeting. Meanwhile Lily tries on Emma's wedding ring and Ryan plans to become CEO. Harlow asks if he should tell them who she really is.

key_events.description: Harlow reveals Emma inherited fifty-one percent of Blake Group
Lily wears Emma's wedding ring and says it suits her better
Harlow asks whether to tell them who Emma really is

ending_cliffhanger.description: Emma says they will find out the hard way

label_reasons.betrayal: Lily with the ring at E2_L10
